svg.title: JEV WHERE?
svg.desc: A seek-and-find poster: a crowd of cartoon code critters (regex blobs, bugs, tickets, if-signs, speech bubbles) with Jev, a small lime mascot holding a magnifying glass, hidden among them. Tagline: a seek-and-find for the decisions hiding in your code.
